purpose: Focused before-and-after evidence for the measured packagedinstallation fresh-lane hotspot
isolation: Three sequential focused runs before and three sequential focused runs after the test-setup change; no UI, functional, lint, or other test lane ran concurrently.

optimization.change: Initialize the validated embedded catalog and stateless persistence composition once in TestMain, reuse one installer in the published-factory loop, and retain per-test temporary roots for independent targets.
optimization.behavioral_scope: All existing install, replace, cancellation, invalid-payload, content-drift, format, and published-factory load assertions remain unchanged.

before.setup: Each test rebuilt the persistence composition; catalog validation was repeated in each catalog-using test; published-factory subtests each created a temporary root.

after.setup: TestMain shares the immutable catalog and stateless persistence composition; the published-factory loop shares its installer while each subtest retains its own temporary root.

notes: The before and after values are package-level Go JSON timing events from the same isolated Windows host and fresh -count=1 policy.

The full-lane baseline separately identifies packagedinstallation as the recurring fresh-run leader; this focused record measures the owner-local setup change without other package processes competing for the host.
All report timestamps and comparisons are UTC-normalized.
